scripts.ci:check: npm run clean && npm run install:package-lock && npm ci && npm run bundle
scripts.ci:test: npm run clean && npm run install:package-lock && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run format-check && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.bundle: npm run check && npm run build && npm run build:package
scripts.compile: npm run command:jq:check && tsc --showConfig | jq -c '.' || tsc --showConfig
scripts.local-test:
sh script/test || if [ $? -eq 127 ]; then printf '\033[1;33m%s `%s`\033[0m
' 'script/test can be generated by running' 'sh script/test.example'; fi
scripts.package:watch:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Packaging project in watch mode...' && npm run package:rollup -- --watch
scripts.clean: npm run command:concurrently:check && concurrently -n clean: -g npm:clean:* || npm run clean-all
scripts.clean:modules:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning node_modules and package-lock.json...' && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.clean:cache:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning npm cache...' && npm cache clean --force
scripts.clean-all: npm run clean:modules && npm run clean:cache && npm run clean:coverage && npm run clean:dist
scripts.coverage:summary: npm run command:jq:check && npm run coverage:jq:summary || npm run command:jq:notfound
scripts.coverage:jq:summary:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Coverage summary totals...' && cat coverage/coverage-summary.json | (jq -c .total 2>/dev/null || printf '\033[1;31m(X) %s\033[0m
' 'Failed to parse coverage summary.')
scripts.command:jq:notfound:
printf '\033[1;33m(!) %s\033[0m
' '`jq` not found, skipping coverage summary.'
scripts.docs:action: npm run docs:clean:action && npm run docs:generate:action
scripts.docs:toolkit: npm run docs:clean:toolkit && npm run docs:generate:toolkit
scripts.docs:generate:action:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating action docs...' && npx typedoc --options typedoc.action.json
scripts.docs:clean:action:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning action docs directory...' && rm -rf docs
scripts.docs:generate:toolkit:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Generating toolkit docs...' && npx typedoc --options src/toolkit/typedoc.json
scripts.docs:clean:toolkit:
printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m
' 'Cleaning toolkit docs directory...' && rm -rf src/toolkit/docs
scripts.postinstall:
printf '\033[1;32m%s:\033[0m\033[0;32m %s\033[0m
' 'Installation complete' 'Run `npm run build` to build the project.'
scripts.prep: npm run fix && npm run build:compile && npm test && npm run build:package
scripts.all: npm run reset && npm run fix && npm run coverage && npm run bundle && npm run docs
